name: Single-Ray Octree Traversal
definition: Ray tracing the octree-encapsulated volume directly, using the octree as an acceleration structure to find a cell primitive. The implicit surface inside each cell is a trilinear interpolant patch; globally this defines a piecewise C0 isosurface.
summary: Single-ray octree traversal renders implicit surfaces by tracing one ray at a time through an octree, prioritizing optimized single-ray performance over the coherence benefits of packet-based techniques.
